text:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke run complete for release r2026-03. Synthetic kv-heartbeat probe failing intermittently in eu-west-1: 5/20 failures, p95 latency increased from ~420ms to 3.8s :warning:

maria: Linking logs and rollout page — https://deploy.internal/r2026-03 (canary -> eu-wide)

alice: Saw similar in canary earlier this morning, errors are HTTP 502 with "kv shard not found" in runtime trace.

ben: Pasted a few lines from the smoke-runner: ```
[smoke] probe=kv-heartbeat shard=eu-west-1 error="kv shard not found" http=502
[smoke] probe=kv-heartbeat latency=3800ms
[smoke] probe=kv-heartbeat attempt=3 status=fail
```

carla: Before we roll back, can someone confirm whether the new runtime (rtx-1.15) is the only change? any pod restarts or config drift?

infra-bot: node-eu-a: restart_count=0; node-eu-b: restart_count=0; env: K8S 1.26; runtime-image: rtx-1.15 (deployed: yes)

ben: Confirmed runtime bumped from rtx-1.14 -> rtx-1.15 in this rollout. Repro command for local smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://smoke.internal/kv-heartbeat -d '{"shard":"eu-west-1"}' -w "%{http_code}"`

maria: Proposal: pin eu-west-1 back to rtx-1.14 (traffic steering) and hold the global rollout. If that stabilizes synth, we avoid full rollback. Who can apply the pin?

ops-jordan: I'll apply the rollout pin now for eu-west-1, routing 100% to rtx-1.14 via the console policy. ETA 2m.

alice: After pin, we'll run 5m of synth checks. Success criteria: failures <=1/20 and p95 < 1.5s.

ops-jordan: Pin applied by ops-jordan — policy ID: pol-8923. Monitoring: https://console.internal/rollouts/pol-8923

deploy-bot: Rollout policy updated (pol-8923) by ops-jordan. Observed synth results (1m window): failures 0/20, p95 420ms :thumbsup:

maria: Good. Hold global rollout. Create a short incident/ticket and assign to eng-runtime for root-cause on rtx-1.15's kv path. We'll also schedule a follow-up to test the kernel change in a staging cluster.

carla: Filing ENG-3219 with initial notes, logs attached. Adding owners: @ben, @alice, eng-runtime.

ben: As a precaution, I'm enabling a temporary circuit-breaker on kv route to limit retries while we investigate.

maria: Thanks all. We'll keep the hold until eng-runtime confirms a fix or patch. Re-check in 30m unless the synth shows regression earlier. :white_check_mark:
